title: AI Startup Baseten Valuation Reaches $30B in New $2B Fundraise
summary:
The AI inference company is dividing its latest capital raise into two distinct tranches to bring in roughly $2 billion in funding, according to people familiar with the matter. The round, led by Sands Capital, values Baseten at $26 billion for one portion of the raise and $30 billion for the second.

The current valuation would more than double the company's $13 billion valuation from June, when it raised $1.5 billion.
